metric_definition: 2*sum(mu-d+d*log(d/mu))/sum(d), all 278x184320 measurement bins, mu=b+Omega*(C x)R; zero observed count contributes mu.
zero_prediction_policy: Positive observed count with zero mean has divergent deviance: report a finite log(float64 tiny) rejection penalty and unsupported_positive_bins>0, always fail/1. This is reporting arithmetic, not physical noise flooring.
threshold_provenance: Predeclared normalized deviance excess budget1e-6 over independently float64-evaluated attainable original30-RL field. The original0.001 source-count closure is unchanged. No true sky or calibrated noise accuracy is claimed.
reference_role: Attainable conditional Poisson reconstruction quality, not injected sky truth or exact ML optimum.
scientific_accuracy_scope: measurement-consistent conditional reconstruction, no unique spatial truth certification
